summary: Privilege escalation can't be limited to specific commands because Ansible runs modules from randomly named temp files; use an unconstrained account or AWX/automation platform to manage credentials instead.
questions: Can I restrict Ansible's sudo access to specific commands?
Why does sudo with allowed command paths break Ansible?

answer_card.title: Escalation can't be limited to specific commands
answer_card.answer_md: Ansible runs modules from temp files with changing names, so sudo/pbrun/doas rules that allow only paths like `/sbin/service` won't match. Use a dedicated account without that restriction, or AWX / the Ansible automation platform to manage indirect access to SSH credentials.
